questions.explanationMd: `remove(1)` calls `remove(int index)`, because an `int` argument matches it exactly, without boxing.

options.explanationMd: Correct! `remove(int)` removes by index, so the element at index 1, the value 2, goes.

questions.bodyMd: Which can be caught with a `catch (Exception e)` block?

options.explanationMd: Correct! Both are subclasses of `Exception`, so that block catches them.

questions.bodyMd: When do virtual threads give the most benefit, and why?
questions.modelAnswerMd: For workloads with many tasks that spend most of their time blocked, such as waiting on I/O. A blocked virtual thread releases its carrier thread, so a few platform threads can serve a very large number of tasks. They give little benefit to CPU-bound work.
